description: This file is a PHP script for editing a port forwarding service configuration in a web-based router interface. It includes server-side PHP code to populate form fields with existing configuration data, client-side JavaScript for form validation and submission via AJAX, and HTML markup for the form and page layout.

methods.name: PHP script execution
methods.description: Contains PHP code that retrieves query parameters and configuration data to dynamically populate the HTML form.

methods.name: JavaScript validation and AJAX submission
methods.description: Defines client-side form validation rules, UI interactions, and AJAX POST request to save changes.
